title: the Sri Yantra
hook: one short word written at the top of the page, before anything else
tomorrow: start at the gate or start at the dot? which way do you read it?

segments.voice: Yesterday, the Sri Yantra in worship: each enclosure greeted in order, edge first and center last, the way a guest arrives. Today, the smallest piece of its name.

A wedding card. A new account book. A letter home. In some Hindu families, before the first real line, someone writes one short word at the very top of the page: Shri. It doesn't say who the letter is for or what the numbers mean. It just goes first, like a blessing set down before the work begins. A grandmother may remind you if you forget it. And it's the same word at the front of the Sri Yantra.
screen: `A CARD, A LEDGER, A LETTER.` → `ONE WORD AT THE TOP.` → `THE SAME WORD AS THE YANTRA.`

segments.voice: Sri, also spelled Shri, is a Sanskrit word with a wide glow around it: radiance, beauty, good fortune, the sense of things going well. It's also a name of the Goddess Lakshmi. And it's used as a mark of honor, set before the names of gods, holy places and respected people. So in Sri Yantra, Sri Chakra and Sri Vidya, the word isn't decoration. It names whose diagram, whose wheel, whose knowledge this is. Now the detail worth telling someone tonight. The Lalita Sahasranama, the hymn of names this run keeps coming back to, opens with Sri. Her first name is Srimata, the auspicious mother. The next is Sri Maharajni, the great queen. The one after names her as queen of a lion throne, and it begins with Sri too. Before the hymn says anything else about her, it says the word for radiance and blessing. So the Sri Yantra is, quite simply, the yantra of Sri: the diagram of the auspicious one. The square, the lotuses, the woven triangles and the point all sit inside one short word, the same one families write at the top of the page before anything else.
screen: `SRI: RADIANCE AND GOOD FORTUNE.` · `A MARK OF HONOR, SET FIRST.` · `HER NAMES OPEN WITH SRI.` · then, large: `A WHOLE DIAGRAM IN ONE SHORT WORD.`

segments.voice: Take a pen and a piece of paper, and at the very top write one word you'd want to go first, before anything else on the page: Shri, if it's part of your family's way, or another word that means blessing to you. Write it slowly. Then sit with the page in front of you and let that one word be all that's on it for a while.
The Sri Yantra: the yantra of Sri, radiance and blessing, the word Lalita's names begin with.
For the road: the Sri Yantra, a whole diagram held inside one short word. That's the day.
